narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Golden Rod, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, the Golden Rod I requested. I never expected it to arrive. I was considering going back to Ironforge to purchase one off the auction house. You saved me a trip, something these old feet greatly thank you for. I do not yet know how I can use this to commune with the Binding Stones, let alone if I even can, but I suspect this brings me one step closer. In the worst case, well, I am happy to have a new cane.
narrative.requestItemsText: <The dwarf seems to be in a deep state of meditation, though your approach interrupted his focus. Fortunately, a smile greets you.>
